notes: Panusimilin - a symmetric bis(2,2-dimethylchromene) caged polyphenol dimer, Acetone-d6. Only COSY is uniformly sampled (HSQC and HMBC are NUS with no nuslist, so no proton-carbon map). The central sp3 methine chain C0(O-CH ~4.46)-C10(2.27)-C9(4.34)-C2 gives the recorded cross-peaks; the 4 aromatic CH sit on tetrasubstituted rings as isolated singlets (no COSY) and the 4 gem-dimethyls are singlets. Cross-peak atom assignments are tentative (no HSQC to confirm which O-CH is C0 vs C2). Strong t1 streaks at 4.46 and 2.27.
